title: Employ staff under the Nurses Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Nurses Award 2020.

sources.title: Nurses Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This occupational award covers: (a) employers throughout Australia in the health industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award; and (b) employers who employ a nurse/midwife, principally engaged in nursing/midwifery duties comprehended by the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions .

confidence_note: Occupational award: the health industry, and any other employer of nurses or midwives (cl 4.1); nurses in schools are excluded (cl 4.3).

assessment.summary: The Nurses Award sets classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates for nurses and midwives, in the health industry and wherever else they are employed.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
